epics.title: Privacy Consent Management
epics.jtbd: When a visitor arrives on the site, I want to be asked for consent before any non-essential trackers load, so that my privacy preferences are respected and the site complies with ePrivacy regulations.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Consent recorded for 100% of unique visitor sessions before non-essential script execution
requirements: R1: Opt-in consent captured before any non-essential cookie or tracker loads
R2: Refusing must be as easy as accepting
R3: The choice is recorded and revocable
R4: Use an established consent platform rather than a hand-rolled banner

slices.title: Implement Consent Banner UI Integration
slices.jtbd: When implementing the consent banner for this epic, I want to integrate an established consent platform into the frontend, so that visitor consent is legally captured and recorded before any tracking occurs.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a new visitor lands on the site
When the initial page load completes
Then a consent banner from an established platform must be visible immediately
Given the consent banner is visible
When the user interacts with it via keyboard or mouse
Then the 'Reject All' option must be as prominent as the 'Accept All' option, all interactive elements must have visible focus, and text must maintain a 4.5:1 contrast ratio (WCAG 2.1 AA)
Given the user makes a choice
Then that choice is recorded, non-essential trackers are only loaded if explicit consent was given, and realistic domain content is present to verify this path end-to-end.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% of tracked events are preceded by a valid explicit consent state

slices.title: QA Verification for Consent Banner
slices.jtbd: When implementing QA for this epic, I want to verify that the consent banner blocks non-essential trackers and accurately records visitor choices, so that the site is legally compliant.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a suite of automated E2E tests covering the full test pyramid
When the tests simulate a new visitor session
Then they must verify no tracking scripts load prior to explicit consent being granted
Given the automated test suite
When the tests interact with the consent banner
Then they must assert that rejecting is as easy as accepting, and that choices are properly recorded and revocable.
slices.tocConstraintRef: E2E testing of third-party script loading
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% pass rate for consent state transitions in E2E tests

epics.title: Platform Telemetry and Measurement
epics.jtbd: When operating the site, I want to measure visitor engagement with my content and external links, so that I know if the site successfully drives interest in my work.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: 100% of key engagement events are reliably captured without data loss
requirements: R1: Measure how many visitors actually read the long-form articles (Goal-Question-Metric: Does the site drive interest? -> Are people reading the articles? -> Scroll depth and time on page metrics)

R2: Measure how many visitors click external links to the podcast or Telegram (Goal-Question-Metric: Does the site drive interest? -> Are people proceeding to other platforms? -> Outbound click metrics)

slices.title: Implement Telemetry Measurement System
slices.jtbd: When implementing telemetry for this epic, I want to instrument engagement events, so that the site's success can be measured according to the defined goals.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a visitor reading an article
When they scroll deeply or spend significant time
Then an engagement metric is captured
Given a visitor exploring the site
When they click an outbound link to Telegram or YouTube
Then an outbound click event is recorded securely.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: No more than 0.1% event dropping under high traffic

slices.title: QA Verification for Telemetry System
slices.jtbd: When implementing QA for this epic, I want to verify that telemetry events are correctly fired, so that the measurement data is accurate.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the automated test suite across unit and E2E layers
When simulated user actions occur
Then the correct metric events must be intercepted in the network layer
Given the telemetry system
When testing event delivery
Then assert no PII is leaked in the payload.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% pass rate for telemetry E2E tests
